summary: Seattle, software engineer, strong interest in Linux and open-source software, experienced in web development, enjoys electronic music (especially Aphex Twin and Autechre), critical of software patents and corporate practices, advocates for security in software development, has a technical background in programming languages (including Perl and Go), has experience with system administration, prefers Arch Linux and FreeBSD, has a history of DJing and music production, values usability and functionality in software design, critical of government and corporate control over technology, engaged in discussions about internet privacy and security.
